newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia set for half-million rouble banknote-C.Bank.
newsitem.headline: Russia set for half-million rouble banknote-C.Bank.

text.p: Russia will introduce a 500,000-rouble banknote next month, central bank deputy chairman Arnold Voilukov told a news conference.
A 100,000-rouble banknote is currently the largest note in circulation, but it is often inadequate in a country where bank transfers are rudimentary and most payments are made in cash.

Half a million roubles is worth just under $90 at current exchange rates. In Soviet times, when the rouble was pegged at an artificial rate of 0.55 to the dollar, it would theoretically have been worth over $900,000.
